Zheng Qinwen defeats Iga Swiatek in US Open quarter-final

Chinese tennis player Zheng Qinwen defeated Poland's Iga Swiatek in the US Open quarter-finals. Zheng came back from a 0-5 deficit in the first set to win the match. The victory marks a significant upset in the tournament.
